# Evening Prayer (Psalm 141:2)

## Emotional Focus
Ending the day by talking to God.

## Key KJV
“Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense.” (Psalm 141:2)

## Gentle Retelling
The psalm says our evening prayers rise up to God like sweet-smelling incense. We can tell Him about our whole day.

## Coloring Prompt
A child kneeling at bedtime with soft lamp light, hands folded in prayer.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Talk to God at bedtime — He watches over you all night.”
